### 2026-09-30 — I made my list for what parts I need to make my joystick, I had to change many of the parts to other items because they were either not what i was looking for, or too expensive. I also made my Github

**1h**

I made my list for what parts I need to make my joystick, I had to change many of the parts to other items because they were either not what i was looking for, or too expensive. I also made my Github codespace and set everything up so that once the parts arrive all I have to do is start.

### 2026-10-01 — Today I redid the code on my github, changed many of the parts that i needed, and made a user guide on my github along with 3d modeling more or less how it is going to be made. It is a very simple ver

**1h**

Today I redid the code on my github, changed many of the parts that i needed, and made a user guide on my github along with 3d modeling more or less how it is going to be made. It is a very simple version of how it should end up working, I 3d modeled the pimoroni myself because there was no free models not blocked by making an account, and the arduino was someone elses model posted for free. this is more or less everything that I need to make the final build, other than the fact that i will need to troubleshoot and actually build it.
